rows.operating_model_note: Asset-light: 73% franchised, 27% managed, <1% owned/leased. IHG employees typically fill GM and Financial Controller roles at managed hotels. System Fund operates at break-even for marketing, loyalty, reservations.

Also corroborated by HotelManagement.net (Jan 2019) listing Allegro Agadir at 321 rooms in Barcelo's Morocco portfolio.
